SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-app-user-id')) as distinct_user_count,
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 hour) as time_bucket
FROM kong
WHERE 
    request.path LIKE '%create%' 
    AND response.body LIKE '%our bid is too low please increase the bid%' 
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time_bucket
ORDER BY time_bucket

WITH ride_starts AS (
    SELECT
        timestamp as start_time,
        JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-app-user-id') as pool_user,
        SUBSTRING(request.uri, 21, 24) as trip_id,
        toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-loc-latitude')) as start_lat,
        toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-loc-longitude')) as start_lon
    FROM kong
    WHERE request.path = '~/talos(?<suffix>/api/v1/trips/[0-9a-fA-F]{24}/arrived)' 
      AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    ORDER BY timestamp DESC
), ride_ends AS (
    SELECT
        timestamp as end_time,
        JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-app-user-id') as pool_user,
        SUBSTRING(request.uri, 21, 24) as trip_id,
        toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-loc-latitude')) as end_lat,
        toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-loc-longitude')) as end_lon
    FROM kong
    WHERE request.path = '~/talos(?<suffix>/api/v1/trips/[0-9a-fA-F]{24}/finish)' 
      AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    ORDER BY timestamp DESC
), ride_details AS (
    SELECT
        ride_ends.pool_user as pool_user,
        ride_starts.trip_id as trip_id,
        start_lat,
        start_lon,
        start_time,
        end_lat,
        end_lon,
        end_time
    FROM
        ride_ends,ride_starts
    WHERE
        ride_ends.trip_id = ride_starts.trip_id
), ride_tracking AS (
    SELECT
        JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-app-user-id') AS pool_user,
        ride_details.trip_id,
        start_time,
        array(start_lon,start_lat) AS start_coords,
        timestamp AS curr_time,
        array(toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-loc-longitude')),toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-loc-latitude'))) AS curr_coords,
        end_time,
        array(end_lon,start_lat) AS end_coords
    FROM
        kong,ride_details
    WHERE
        ride_details.pool_user = JSONExtractString(kong.request.headers, 'x-app-user-id') AND
        kong.timestamp > ride_details.start_time AND
        kong.timestamp < ride_details.end_time
    ORDER BY
        timestamp DESC
)

WITH ride_starts AS (
    SELECT
        timestamp as start_time,
        JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-app-user-id') as pool_user,
        toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-loc-latitude')) as start_lat,
        toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-loc-longitude')) as start_lon
    FROM kong
    WHERE request.path = '~/talos(?<suffix>/api/v1/trips/[0-9a-fA-F]{24}/arrived)' 
      AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
ride_ends AS (
    SELECT
        timestamp as end_time,
        JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-app-user-id') as pool_user,
        toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-loc-latitude')) as end_lat,
        toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-loc-longitude')) as end_lon
    FROM kong
    WHERE request.path = '~/talos(?<suffix>/api/v1/trips/[0-9a-fA-F]{24}/finish)' 
      AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
matched_rides AS (
    SELECT
        s.pool_user,
        s.start_time,
        e.end_time,
        s.start_lat,
        s.start_lon,
        e.end_lat,
        e.end_lon,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.pool_user, s.start_time 
                          ORDER BY e.end_time) as rn
    FROM ride_starts s
    JOIN ride_ends e ON s.pool_user = e.pool_user 
                     AND s.start_time < e.end_time
                     AND greatCircleDistance(s.start_lat, s.start_lon, e.end_lat, e.end_lon) < 500
),
ride_windows AS (
    SELECT
        pool_user,
        groupArray(start_time) as start_times,
        groupArray(end_time) as end_times,
        groupArray(start_lat) as start_lats,
        groupArray(start_lon) as start_lons,
        groupArray(end_lat) as end_lats,
        groupArray(end_lon) as end_lons
    FROM matched_rides
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY pool_user
)

SELECT
    JSONExtractString(k.request.headers, 'x-app-user-id') as pool_user,
    toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(k.request.headers, 'x-loc-latitude')) as lat,
    toFloat64OrZero(JSONExtractString(k.request.headers, 'x-loc-longitude')) as lon,
    xxHash64(pool_user)/1000 as color_id,
    k.timestamp,
    arrayFirst(start_time -> 
        k.timestamp BETWEEN start_time AND 
        rw.end_times[indexOf(rw.start_times, start_time)], 
        rw.start_times
    ) as ride_start_time,
    arrayFirst(end_time -> 
        k.timestamp BETWEEN 
        rw.start_times[indexOf(rw.end_times, end_time)] AND end_time, 
        rw.end_times
    ) as ride_end_time
FROM kong k
JOIN ride_windows rw ON JSONExtractString(k.request.headers, 'x-app-user-id') = rw.pool_user
WHERE arrayExists(i -> k.timestamp BETWEEN rw.start_times[i] AND rw.end_times[i], 
                  arrayEnumerate(start_times))
  AND $__timeFilter(k.timestamp)
ORDER BY k.timestamp
